home.title: Welcome to the Jellyfin plug-ins help
home.intro: Two free plug-ins for Jellyfin 10.11 and 12, from one repository address: Picture shrinker makes the pictures Jellyfin keeps smaller, and Audio description finds, tags and plays described sound tracks. Start by adding the address to Jellyfin.

areas.intro: Add the one repository address to Jellyfin, then install the plug-ins you want.

featured.title: One address for both plug-ins
featured.text: Add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TheMightyTRex/jellyfin-plugins/main/manifest.json to Jellyfin once, and both plug-ins appear in its catalogue, with their updates. Go to Dashboard, Plugins, Manage Repositories, then New Repository; on a Plugins page with tabs, the Repositories tab, then +.
featured.flow:
start: Dashboard, then Plugins
step1: Manage Repositories
step2: New Repository
step3: Enter the address, then Add
end: The plug-ins are in Available

footer_note: **Use description tracks you have the right to use.** Audio description adds a description track you already have, such as one from AudioVault. Get each track yourself, keep to the rules of the site it comes from, and use it only with a copy of the film you own. The plug-ins download nothing from any website.
